gaps.sentence: He suggested ___ a taxi instead of walking.
gaps.explanation: suggest + -ing (no infinitive with a person: suggest that we take is also possible).

gaps.sentence: He apologized for ___ so abrupt in the meeting.
I look forward to ___ your suggestions at the meeting.
It took me ages ___ used to the new keyboard.
gaps.explanation: it takes time + to-infinitive: took me ages to get used to the keyboard.

gaps.sentence: You should stop ___ so much coffee late at night.
gaps.explanation: stop + -ing = end the activity: stop drinking coffee.

gaps.sentence: I tried ___ the shelf up, but it was too heavy.
gaps.explanation: try + to-infinitive = attempt, make an effort.

gaps.sentence: Remember ___ your passport to the airport.
gaps.explanation: remember + to-infinitive = not forget to do something.
